title: Grateful Dead Live at The Centrum on 1987-04-03
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi CR-7A) > Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.8 MHz) >KORG AudioGate 4 > Samplitude Pro X3 Suite > FLAC/24

ai_review.summary: Excellent matrix recording with a vibrant audience that adds historic charm to great music
ai_review.review: The UltraMatrix source captures both the band and an engaging crowd, delivering a lively listening experience that reminds fans of classic tapes like the 6/24/1970 Capitol Theater show. The performance is praised as great throughout, and the prominent audience ambience enhances the overall vibe.

ai_rating.rationale: Single five‑star review emphasizes both strong musical performance and a compelling audience mix; rating reflects excellent show and recording but limited data lowers confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Audience is clearly audible and adds historic atmosphere; no reported flaws, overall crisp blend of soundboard and crowd.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Described as a very different show with strong audience interaction that enhances the musical flow.
